units.source_text: 云居雁不知道夕雾与落叶公主的关系究竟如何，

en.t: Kumoi no Kari did not know what the relationship between Yugiri and Princess Ochiba really was,

units.source_text: 她以前只见夕雾和老夫人有通信来往，而且写得非常详细，却不见落叶公主来信，觉得莫名其妙。

en.t: Previously, she had only seen Yugiri exchanging letters with the old lady, writing in great detail, while no letters came from Princess Ochiba, and she found it utterly puzzling.

units.source_text: 有一天，夕雾躺着，怅望夕暮天空，耽入沉思。

en.t: One day, Yugiri lay down, gazing wistfully at the evening sky and sinking deep into thought.

units.source_text: 云居雁差她的小儿子送一字条去，一张小纸的一端写着：

en.t: Kumoi no Kari sent her young son to deliver a short note, written on one end of a small sheet of paper:
